bayts.text: There has yielded to me, from Him Who favoured me with what I sought, a mighty Book that repelled my harm when it appeared.
An Everlasting One I call on intimately – and His praise – gives me glad tidings, with a wise Remembrance brought by a Messenger who laid down the Sunna.
Allah, since He granted me the outpouring together with His garden, has erased my suffering from Satan, men and jinn.
Toward him to whom all my being has turned, (have turned) my ink and my pens; and He has been a benefactor to me.
My Lord, my Teacher, leads the sciences of the unseen to my breast, in an outpouring that shows the word and the meaning.
My months and my years have become the best obedience for Him Who through my works has guided whoever attends to them.
My pens bring a worshipper to Allah, without seclusion (khalwa); and Allah has made abide as He has enriched.
The gifts of my Lord have led reward and good pleasure to us, just as He has made life and dwelling good.
I have taken in beneficial sciences by the word "Be!", and my Lord has led to me the best increase beyond the finest good (Qurʾān 10:26).
My Master repelled what afflicted me before I saw it, and I became His servant, the servant of the possessor of the highest splendours.
It has become clear to me that Allah: there is no lord besides Him, and that the Messenger of Allah has surpassed creation in beauty.
I have written, and I am grateful, not complaining: and Allah has erased from me what afflicted me when it appeared.
